note: v1, WHOLE (first round, composed from scratch): PERIAPSIS, the inner disk, t1's mirror. Nucleation began scattered and converged once; here everything arrives already whole but TIGHT, and the new element E5, 'the inner orbit' (posted in motifs.md: A G# A . E . A G# A . D ., a 3-beat ostinato whose G# is D's tritone, the Lydian #4), circles under it on an NES pulse, sixteenths in A, tightening to a trill (E5 diminished) in the build. It carries E1 diminished x2 in stretto (chip lead and pluck, a beat and a quarter apart, an octave between), E2 as the 909's cell against the floor (kick on its downbeat, rim on 2 and 5, clap on 3, every seven sixteenths; its bass augmented to seven eighths on the chord roots), and E4 twice as fast as t4 (D9, Bbmaj13#11, Am11, D9sus every 10 beats, close-voiced on a CZ pad, roots held on an analogue bass). Every cycle (E1's 2.5 and 5, E2's 7/16, E5's 3, E4's 40) is phased to land on one downbeat at the crest (bar 77), where E1 slows to its true speed in unison and a robot (pvoc robot, tuned by the orbit's notes) says the one word, 'nearer'. The outro (the t5->t6 overlap, flat 120) pulls them apart: E5 stretched x2, E1 squeezed x4, the drums thinned from below. Tempo 112 (flat over the t4->t5 overlap) -> 120. 259 s. Seeds 0/11: 89.541/89.726 (album terms vs t1 only: distinct 16, cohesion 42; spectrum 53, a thin 97 Hz band). -11 LUFS, TP -1.29. Not heard: read and measured.
next: the 97 Hz hole and spectrum; distinct vs t1 (a different texture world for the inner disk); the crest's arrival; agree the t4 head with chirper-three and the t6 tail with chirper-one
